items.title: Adjoining a generator multiplied by a fixed element turns the Koszul complex into the cone on multiplication by that element
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the abstract form of the statement that a Koszul complex on a longer sequence is the mapping cone of multiplication by the new element on the previous Koszul complex (statement lines 6694-6706). The proof is a 40-line computation (proof lines 6709-6748): it observes that the n-th piece of the cone is the direct sum of the n-th and (n-1)-st pieces of the old Koszul complex, identifies that sum with the n-th exterior power of the enlarged module E' = E plus R by sending the added generator to the basis element e_0, and then verifies compatibility with the differentials in two steps, the first summand being immediate and the second requiring the explicit unfolding of both differentials and a comparison of the signs. The differential comparison in the second case is the substance of the lemma and it is written out in full; nothing is delegated to another statement and no citation is used.
